description: This file provides session resolution utilities for managing session keys, visibility, and related logic in a system, including functions for resolving session references, checking visibility, and normalizing session keys.

methods.name: normalizeKey
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a session key string or returns undefined if input is undefined or empty.

methods.name: resolveMainSessionAlias
methods.description: Determines the main session key and alias based on configuration, with scope defaulting to 'per-sender'.

methods.name: resolveDisplaySessionKey
methods.description: Returns 'main' if the key matches alias or mainKey, otherwise returns the key itself.

methods.name: resolveInternalSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves special session keys like 'current' and 'main' to internal representations.

methods.name: listSpawnedSessionKeys
methods.description: Lists session keys spawned by a given session key, with optional limit.

methods.name: isRequesterSpawnedSessionVisible
methods.description: Checks if a target session is visible to a requester session, considering spawning relationships.

methods.name: shouldVerifyRequesterSpawnedSessionVisibility
methods.description: Determines if visibility verification is needed based on parameters.

methods.name: isResolvedSessionVisibleToRequester
methods.description: Checks if a session is visible to a requester, considering restrictions and session relationships.

methods.name: looksLikeSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a valid session key based on known patterns.

methods.name: shouldResolveSessionIdInput
methods.description: Decides if an input should be resolved as a session ID based on its pattern.

methods.name: resolveSessionReference
methods.description: Resolves a session key or ID to a session reference, considering visibility and special keys.

methods.name: resolveVisibleSessionReference
methods.description: Verifies if a resolved session is visible to the requester.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalKey
methods.description: Normalizes an optional session key string.

methods.name: __testing.setDepsForTest
methods.description: Allows overriding dependencies for testing purposes.
